mapper.sql: conversation.status = 'closed' AND completion.data IS NOT NULL AND conversation.closed_at IS NOT NULL
mapper.select: WITH runs AS ( SELECT conversation.id, conversation.title, conversation.module_id, conversation.status, conversation.closed_at, () AS completed FROM group_conversation conversation LEFT JOIN trpg_completion completion ON completion.conversation_id = conversation.id WHERE conversation.user_world_id = #{userWorldId} AND conversation.mode = 'trpg' ), activity AS ( SELECT message.conversation_id, MAX(message.created_at) AS last_played_at FROM group_chat_message message JOIN runs ON runs.id = message.conversation_id WHERE message.visibility = 'public' AND message.status = 'completed' AND message.message_kind != 'system_event' GROUP BY message.conversation_id ), participation AS ( SELECT DISTINCT member.actor_id AS character_id, runs.* FROM runs JOIN group_chat_member member ON member.conversation_id = runs.id WHERE member.actor_type = 'character' ), totals AS ( SELECT character_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE completed) AS completed_run_count FROM participation GROUP BY character_id ), recent AS ( SELECT participation.*, activity.last_played_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY participation.character_id ORDER BY activity.last_played_at DESC, participation.id DESC) AS rn FROM participation JOIN activity ON activity.conversation_id = participation.id WHERE activity.last_played_at IS NOT NULL ) SELECT character.character_id, COALESCE(totals.completed_run_count, 0) AS completed_run_count, recent.id AS conversation_id, recent.title, recent.module_id, module.name AS module_name, CASE WHEN recent.completed THEN 'completed' ELSE recent.status END AS status, recent.last_played_at, CASE WHEN recent.completed THEN recent.closed_at END AS completed_at FROM user_character_info character LEFT JOIN totals ON totals.character_id = character.character_id LEFT JOIN recent ON recent.character_id = character.character_id AND recent.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN coc_module module ON module.id = recent.module_id WHERE character.user_world_id = #{userWorldId} ORDER BY character.character_id
